svg.title: Package Bzy_MHz and package temperature over 420 seconds of 8-thread load, at 2.4 GHz with turbo off and at 3.4 GHz with turbo on
svg.desc: At 2.4 GHz the package frequency holds flat at 2400 MHz and temperature settles near 82 C. At 3.4 GHz turbo the frequency alternates between the 800 MHz floor and about 3000 MHz while package temperature pins at 100 C: 83 of 424 intervals sit at the floor and the run accumulated 283,300 throttle events.
svg.text: seconds under load (1 Hz turbostat intervals)
